'''We Will Meet Again''' is the ending theme for the English [[dub]] of ''[[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]''. It plays during the ending credits and was written, produced, and performed by [[John Siegler]]. [[Jim Malone]] wrote the song with Siegler.
